facts.text: I brought a boombox and enough snacks for two. Diane, I'm hoping you'll stay for dinner.
facts.why: Not a Lloyd line. A real one-liner of his on Wikiquote about work fits the kiosk layout.
facts.fix: I don't want to sell anything, buy anything, or process anything as a career.

fix_note.text: I don't want to sell anything, buy anything, or process anything as a career.

facts.text: Sweet and salty road trip snack mix
facts.why: There is no road trip in the film. Lloyd and Diane drive around Seattle and fly to England at the end.
facts.fix: Sweet and salty driving lesson snack mix

facts.text: The driving lesson by the petrol station.
facts.why: Lloyd does teach Diane to drive her manual Ford Tempo, but no source places the lesson by a petrol station. The petrol station is where Lloyd hangs out with his mates.
facts.fix: Lloyd teaching Diane to drive stick.

facts.text: Lloyd's road trip pick, In Your Eyes playing.
facts.why: No road trip. 'In Your Eyes' plays when they have sex in the car and again on the boombox under Diane's window at dawn.
facts.fix: Lloyd's pick, In Your Eyes playing.

facts.text: Saturday night at the Gas n' Sip.
facts.why: Lloyd and his mates do hang out at a petrol station, but none of the pages opened gives its name or says it is a Saturday night.
facts.fix: Lloyd and the guys at the petrol station.

vibe.verdict: Boombox, trench coat and kickboxer are all here, but the weather-board kiosk could be anywhere and the food does not say Seattle in 1989.
